reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is to quantify the reliability of a point-spread pick using observable market data. We decompose this into four independent components: consensus among bookmakers, market depth (number of participants), pricing efficiency relative to fair value, and the stability of the quoted spread. Each component is scored separately to avoid multicollinearity, then aggregated to produce a final confidence metric. This modular approach allows for clear attribution of risk and enables systematic backtesting of each kernel's predictive power.
